# Morgan Hunt

> Staff Software Engineer in Mesa, AZ. 8+ years in Dart and Flutter. Architected Couchsurfing's mobile app from an empty repo to 1.3M lines of production code serving 25M+ members, and leads the team of 9 engineers who build on it. Previously grew a meal-planning app 5× to 10K+ monthly active users as its sole developer, on a product doing over $1M a year at 4.8 stars. Maintains 24 packages on pub.dev — including two full backend frameworks, Revali and Zonai — downloaded ~208K times a month.

## By the numbers

Scale:

- **25M+ users reached** — Couchsurfing's global member base, served by the mobile app he architected.
- **~208K downloads/month** — across 24 packages published to pub.dev.
- **~2.33M lines of code** — 1.03M across 94 non-fork repositories (938K of it Dart) plus the 1.3M-line Couchsurfing app, excluding vendored third-party code and built output.
- **5,516 GitHub contributions in the last 12 months** — 3,461 commits and 1,497 code reviews.

Impact:

- **$1M+ annual revenue** generated by the Clean Simple Eats app he built and maintained.
- **9 engineers led** — the mobile team he leads and mentors, owning technical direction and standards.
- **1.3M lines architected** — the Couchsurfing Flutter app specifically, from an empty repo.
- **4.8-star App Store rating** across 5,700+ ratings.
- **5× user growth** — ~2K to 10K+ monthly active users, as the sole developer.
- **2,382 pull requests reviewed** and **947 shipped** (913 merged) on a 67-contributor monorepo.
- **Two-week release cadence** sustained across iOS and Android for 3.5 years.

Open source:

- **24 packages** on pub.dev; **2** backend frameworks built end to end; **6** packages at a perfect 160/160 pub.dev score.
- **1M+ lines of his own code** across personal projects, separate from anything built at work.
- **64 public non-fork repositories** (94 total), 51 of them Dart.

The home page renders as an interactive terminal (commands like `metrics`, `experience`, `ls projects`, `about`), with a plain-HTML fallback for readers that don't run scripts. `/resume` is the full résumé as text and is the best page to read for background, work history, and skills.

## Flagship frameworks

- [Revali](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/revali): A Dart backend framework inspired by NestJS — decorators, DI, and generated routing. Docs at [revali.dev](https://revali.dev).
- [Zonai](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/zonai): A batteries-included Dart backend framework — schema-first auth, typed database layer, live query streams, storage, cron, and access rules. Built on Revali's router. Docs at [zonai.dev](https://zonai.dev).

## Other projects

- [sip](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/sip): A CLI for Dart mono-repos — run scripts, tests, and pub commands across every package.
- [hooksman](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/hooksman): Git hooks and tasks defined as Dart scripts or shell commands — a Dart-native Husky.
- [equatable_gen](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/equatable_gen): Auto-generates `props` getters for classes using the equatable package.
- [import_ozempic](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/import_ozempic): Replaces Dart barrel imports with direct source imports.
- [change_case](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/change_case): Convert strings between camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and more.
- [contacts](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/contacts): An iMessage app and companion iOS app for searching contacts by any field and sharing them as vCards.
- [minesweeper](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/minesweeper): Classic Minesweeper, recreated for the command line.
- [snake](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/snake): Classic Snake, recreated for the command line.
- [gun_fu](https://github.com/mrgnhnt96/gun_fu): A terminal game about a gunfight.

## Optional

- [oat](https://mrgnhnt.com/): A macOS app for managing shell aliases, functions, env vars, and PATH entries — no public repo yet.
